title: SYN443 protected adaptive TCP runtime input
description: In-progress, not an activated policy capability. The complete UTF-8 object is limited to 196608 bytes and the complete engine document to 262144 bytes. Dedicated bounded decoders must validate both opaque JSON payloads before construction; this outer schema alone does not validate their contents or grant route authority.

graphB64.description: Canonical unpadded base64url of the closed route-graph JSON. After decoding, enforce the shared graph schema, exact catalogue binding, depth/node/byte limits and duplicate/case/UTF-8 rules. PUBLIC is eligibility for a public intent, never observed exit proof.

catalogueB64.description: Canonical unpadded base64url of the canonical normalized outbound map keyed by local hop ID. At most 500 unique profiles, each at most 65536 bytes, with a decoded aggregate ceiling of 262144 bytes and the stricter complete wire/engine limits. The dedicated decoder, normalized profile validator and actual context-bound constructor are all required. This protected payload contains credentials and must not enter inventory, logs, telemetry or ordinary diff DTOs.

groups.description: Exact graph group ID to unique managed outbound tag mapping. Reject missing/extra groups, duplicate tags, reserved tags and conflicts with configured static outbounds. Each tag must have the exact approved route_checks and actual TCP capabilities; public intents require a matching fresh country predicate.
